I believe they can. They can also use cards that don't require Disciplines
(e.g. Dodge, Boxed In, Open Grate, Lucky Blow, etc.). They just can't heal
normally(i.e. hunting), are burnt instead of going into torpor,
can never diabelrize or get skill cards or anything else that requires
generation. I wouldn't let them call votes, either, because they aren't part
of vampire society.

But this is just the way I play. It's a good question. But, it would make me
sad if Tom Wylie rules that my Muddled Vampire Hunter can't grab the Senguir
Dagger and do 4 agg.s First Strike to anything it wants to. :-)

Messages.Author: Josh Hsu
Messages.Body:
I'm not sure if rising fury is a strike card or not, but keep in mind you can
only use 1 strike card/strike. Also I have no idea what 10k faces is...is it
like mask of 1k faces?

>But this is just the way I play. It's a good question. But, it would make me
>sad if Tom Wylie rules that my Muddled Vampire Hunter can't grab the Senguir
>Dagger and do 4 agg.s First Strike to anything it wants to. :-)

The MVH does 1 strike at first strike, so if the senguir dagger normally does
1 aggravated damage, then MVH w/ dagger would do 1 aggravated damage first
strike, not 4. If dagger says strike:normal hand damage is now aggravated,
then ignore this part (I don't think it does though...)

>Rising Fury for bunches of damage. (I think Chester also had
>a sword, but I'm not sure)
>
>That way I used all the gear of both of the vampires, and that
>doesn't seem quite right. But the card (10K faces) said at any point
>in the combat (I don't have it here, so could be wrong) 10K faces
>could be used.

Mask of 1,000 Faces is the card I think you're talking about, right?
That card is an action modifier, which can't be used when you're in
combat. The action is over and done by the time you get into combat
(see the discussion about Cat's Guidance for more), and action
mofidiers can only be used to modify an action in progress. Once
you're in combat the only cards you can use are the combat cards with
the little arrows on them. So your vampire in combat has to stay
with it once combat starts. It's possible to use Mask right before
combat, but not once you've actually started a round.

>
>Another question, can Allies use gear?
>

Any minion can equip, and allies are minions, so any ally can get a
given piece of equipment and then use it, unless its use is restricted
to vampires (such as Aaron's Feeding Razor).

be used with first strike, but would only deal 1 aggravated damage.

It's an action modifier played by another vampire than the acting minion.
The rulebook doesn't say you cannot use action modifiers anytime during an

Yup, as long as you have equipped them with the equipment. This is a

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Michael Constant <mco...@soda.CSUA.Berkeley.EDU> wrote:
>What about a vampire? Does Zack North with a Sengir Dagger do 2 aggravated
>or just 1? I would assume 2, because Zack North (unlike Muddles) says that
>he has 2 *hand* damage, and it says in the rulebook that hand damage mod-
>ifiers can be used with melee weapons...

Hand damage modifiers such as "+1 hand damage" can boost either hand
strikes or melee weapons. However, Zack North doesn't say "+1 hand damage",
but says "2 hand damage", so just resets his basic hand damage, and only does
1 damage with the Sengir Dagger (for example).
